bibl.title: A Re-transcription and Analysis of a Possible Apocryphal Gospel Fragment, Papyrus Oxyrhynchus II 210, Utilizing a Digital Microscope.
bibl.seg: Brent C. Landau, A Re-transcription and Analysis of a Possible Apocryphal Gospel Fragment, Papyrus Oxyrhynchus II 210, Utilizing a Digital Microscope.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. II, 210 (= van Haelst 1151; LDAB 5222). - 1. Papyrological analysis of P.Oxy. 210 [a date of the late third century to the first third of the fourth century for 210 seems the most likely]. - 2. Previous editions and reconstructions of P.Oxy. 210. - 3. Transcription of P.Oxy. 210 with commentary. - 4. A limited reconstruction of P.Oxy. 210. - Conclusion.
